enabled_features.description: List of guest agent features to enable (e.g., osconfig, guest-attributes, windows-ssh, windows-gmsa).

logging_level.description: Logging verbosity level (0=INFO, 1=DEBUG, 2=TRACE). Higher values produce more verbose logs.

log_file.description: Path where guest agent writes its log file.

metadata_server_url.description: URL of the Google Compute Engine metadata server. Only change if using a custom metadata proxy.

instance_id.description: Override the instance ID read from metadata (advanced, rarely needed). Leave empty to auto-detect.

project_id.description: Override the project ID read from metadata (advanced, rarely needed). Leave empty to auto-detect.

region.description: Override the region read from metadata (e.g., for hybrid or cross-region deployments).

password_rotation_enabled.description: Enable automatic password rotation via OS Login or Windows credential provider.

ssh_keys_enabled.description: Enable SSH key management from metadata (required for Linux OS Login SSH).

oslogin_enabled.description: Enable OS Login support for centralized IAM-based SSH and sudo.

hostname_update_enabled.description: Update the instance's hostname from the metadata server (e.g., to match DNS or inventory).

extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments passed directly to the guest agent binary. Use sparingly.
